decisions.reason: The message clarifies power-connector roles between already established boards but does not change the four-board topology.
The LED requirement already specifies a 5V supply from the power board; clarification of the main-to-sensor-board pass-through connector does not change LED power or data behavior.
Connector electrical roles and references do not change the power board's battery-connector placement, orientation, accessibility, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source does not change board dimensions, installation orientation, mounting, USB-C placement, or aspect ratio.
The source describes normal interboard 5V and 3V3 connector direction and does not alter standalone USB power activation, regulation, OR-ing, or powered loads.
Connector naming and rail direction do not affect the established four-layer PCB stack.
The source does not discuss the charge-status LED, J_LED_CHG, CHGLED circuitry, or component population.
Passing 3V3 from the power board through the main board to the sensor board is consistent with the existing DCDC1 downstream-sensor role and adds no changed regulation requirement.
J_PWR_PWR and J_SENSOR_PWR are power-interface connectors, not panel button, switch, reset, or touch connectors.
The source clarifies power-rail connectors only and does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, topology, speed, or cable assumptions.
Confirmation that 5V is forwarded to the sensor board is consistent with powering 5V sensors and does not alter the boost converter, enable GPIO, default state, load inventory, or current rating.
The interboard power-connector clarification does not change the battery NTC terminal, J_BAT assignment, or AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior.
